description: Defines the NtlmBufferReader class for bounds-checked buffer operations in NTLM protocol implementation, including methods for reading various data types, security buffers, and message parsing.

classes.name: NtlmBufferReader
classes.description: A class providing bounds-checked reading of NTLM message buffers, supporting sequential reads, security buffer parsing, and message validation.

methods.name: NtlmBufferReader
methods.description: Default constructor.

methods.name: NtlmBufferReader(base::span<const uint8_t> buffer)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a buffer span; buffer must outlive the reader.

methods.name: ~NtlmBufferReader
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.description: Returns the total length of the buffer.

methods.name: GetCursor
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position.

methods.name: IsEndOfBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the cursor has reached or passed the end of the buffer.

methods.name: CanRead
methods.description: Checks if there are enough bytes remaining to read a specified length.

methods.name: CanReadFrom
methods.description: Checks if a specified range starting at offset can be read.

methods.name: ReadUInt16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian unsigned integer.

methods.name: ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian unsigned integer.

methods.name: ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit little-endian unsigned integer.

methods.name: ReadFlags
methods.description: Reads a uint32_t and casts it to NegotiateFlags.

methods.name: ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into a span.

methods.name: ReadBytesFrom
methods.description: Reads bytes from a security buffer's offset and length into a span.

methods.name: ReadPayloadAsBufferReader
methods.description: Reads payload from a security buffer into a new NtlmBufferReader.

methods.name: ReadSecurityBuffer
methods.description: Reads an 8-byte security buffer structure.

methods.name: ReadAvPairHeader
methods.description: Reads an AV pair header, returning its ID and length.

methods.name: ReadMessageType
methods.description: Reads the message type from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadTargetInfo
methods.description: Parses target info as a sequence of AV pairs.

methods.name: ReadTargetInfoPayload
methods.description: Reads target info payload and parses as AV pairs.

methods.name: SkipSecurityBuffer
methods.description: Skips over a security buffer structure.

methods.name: SkipSecurityBufferWithValidation
methods.description: Skips over a security buffer with validation.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: MatchSignature
methods.description: Checks for NTLM signature at current position.

methods.name: MatchMessageType
methods.description: Checks if message type matches expected.

methods.name: MatchMessageHeader
methods.description: Checks signature and message type.

methods.name: MatchZeros
methods.description: Checks if next bytes are all zeros.

methods.name: MatchEmptySecurityBuffer
methods.description: Checks if security buffer is empty.
